text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio didn't show up even though it was time for training.
I found her right in front of the hollow of a giant tree.
It is said to be a place where Umamusume vent their frustration and helplessness, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I'm de-finitely!
gonna become just like the Pre-z~!!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
This is, like, a hype boost!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There's no rule saying you can only shout
painful or frustrating things into this tree hollow, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Shouting out what you wanna do or who you wanna be
feels so refreshing and gets you fired up!
choice_data_list: That's fine, but what about training?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Aaaaahhh!!
Sorry, I completely forgot~!!

Seeing Tokai Teio apologize over and over with such genuine remorse,
I decided to forgive her.
